21.passageMeaning: The milk is taken, and even the residue is extracted: everything is taken, down to the last bit.
translationGuidance: Preserve the concrete milk-pot image and the sense of complete extraction together.
Do not soften the action to merely drinking or pouring milk; even the remaining residue is taken.
Do not specify the residue as cream, curds, whey, or another dairy product without further confirmation.
Use natural literary phrasing in each target language while preserving the approved meaning.
